segment.source: I have met this strange being that calls himself Rahm-Umbra. What can you tell me about him?<end>
segment.target: I have met this strange being that calls himself Rahm-Umbra. What can you tell me about him?<end>

segment.source: He is not one of us, but we treat him as an equal. He is our ally, and we cooperated on more than one occasion.<end>
segment.target: He is not one of us, but we treat him as an equal. He is our ally, and we cooperated on more than one occasion.<end>

segment.source: Where did he come from?<end>
segment.target: Where did he come from?<end>

segment.source:
We do not know. He is from afar. The technology at his disposal is far more advanced than ours and trivializes it completely. However, more impressive is his knowledge and understanding of this world, and we consider ourselves fortunate to have had even a fragment of it shared with us.
You should too.<end>
segment.target:
We do not know. He is from afar. The technology at his disposal is far more advanced than ours and trivializes it completely. However, more impressive is his knowledge and understanding of this world, and we consider ourselves fortunate to have had even a fragment of it shared with us.
You should too.<end>

segment.source: Are there any other people in Deep Caverns I could talk to?<end>
segment.target: Are there any other people in Deep Caverns I could talk to?<end>

segment.source: Yes. In the cavern straight to the west of here lives an old man who appears to have been living in Deep Caverns for a long period of time. We read his mind when one of our patrols encountered him, and it was a chaotic one.<end>
segment.target: Yes. In the cavern straight to the west of here lives an old man who appears to have been living in Deep Caverns for a long period of time. We read his mind when one of our patrols encountered him, and it was a chaotic one.<end>

segment.source: Meaning?<end>
segment.target: Meaning?<end>

segment.source: He is insane. We could not extract much useful information from him due to this very reason, but as he is not a threat to us or our goals we took no action against him. He was seen near the warehouse block a few more times but would retreat as soon as he noticed our presence.<end>
segment.target: He is insane. We could not extract much useful information from him due to this very reason, but as he is not a threat to us or our goals we took no action against him. He was seen near the warehouse block a few more times but would retreat as soon as he noticed our presence.<end>

segment.source: I see. I had other questions.<end>
segment.target: I see. I had other questions.<end>

segment.source: You may ask them.<end>
segment.target: You may ask them.<end>

segment.source: Actually, I'll go and pay him a visit right now. See you later.<end>
segment.target: Actually, I'll go and pay him a visit right now. See you later.<end>

segment.source: What's the deal with the Cube? What is it and why is it so important?<end>
segment.target: What's the deal with the Cube? What is it and why is it so important?<end>

segment.source: Why is the Cube important to you?<end>
segment.target: Why is the Cube important to you?<end>

segment.source: I came all the way here because of that bloody thing so I might as well know something about it.<end>
segment.target: I came all the way here because of that bloody thing so I might as well know something about it.<end>

segment.source: It is a power source.<end>
segment.target: It is a power source.<end>

segment.source: A power source?<end>
segment.target: A power source?<end>

segment.source: Yes. <end>
segment.target: Yes. <end>

segment.source:
You don't have the capacity to understand how it functions nor how it is used; even if you did, that information may not be shared with you. I will only say that "the Cube" was taken from us and that we must retrieve it.
If the Cube is exploited, the consequences could prove disastrous.<end>
segment.target:
You don't have the capacity to understand how it functions nor how it is used; even if you did, that information may not be shared with you. I will only say that "the Cube" was taken from us and that we must retrieve it.
If the Cube is exploited, the consequences could prove disastrous.<end>

segment.source: How was the Cube taken from you?<end>
segment.target: How was the Cube taken from you?<end>

segment.source: Stolen. By an agent of an organization we aren't familiar with, and all due to our fault; we failed to see through his deception.<end>
segment.target: Stolen. By an agent of an organization we aren't familiar with, and all due to our fault; we failed to see through his deception.<end>

segment.source: So you tracked this agent to Core City?<end>
segment.target: So you tracked this agent to Core City?<end>

segment.source: Yes. After that his trail disappears.<end>
segment.target: Yes. After that his trail disappears.<end>

segment.source: <end>
segment.target: <end>

segment.source: Your mind offered us another possibility of his allegiance: Oculus. We weren't aware that such an organization even exists, let alone to try and connect it to the device's disappearance.<end>
segment.target: Your mind offered us another possibility of his allegiance: Oculus. We weren't aware that such an organization even exists, let alone to try and connect it to the device's disappearance.<end>

segment.source: But these details are of secondary importance; device's retrieval is of primary.<end>
segment.target: But these details are of secondary importance; device's retrieval is of primary.<end>

segment.source: You are not telling me much.<end>
segment.target: You are not telling me much.<end>

segment.source: I am telling you what you need to know. The Cube must be returned to us. We know where the Cube is located, but we currently do not possess the means to retrieve it.<end>
segment.target: I am telling you what you need to know. The Cube must be returned to us. We know where the Cube is located, but we currently do not possess the means to retrieve it.<end>

segment.source: You can't get past that field, right?<end>
segment.target: You can't get past that field, right?<end>

segment.source: Correct. Its degenerative effect is something we haven't been able to circumvent or counteract. It seems to be especially more potent against our kind than it is against lifeforms with different types of neural activity. <end>
segment.target: Correct. Its degenerative effect is something we haven't been able to circumvent or counteract. It seems to be especially more potent against our kind than it is against lifeforms with different types of neural activity. <end>

segment.source: What does that exactly mean?<end>
segment.target: What does that exactly mean?<end>

segment.source: It means that Tchort's influence is not exerted to the same degree across all affected life forms. The more complex the neural activity of the unit is, the greater the interference, resulting in a more destructive effect to the affected organism.<end>
segment.target: It means that Tchort's influence is not exerted to the same degree across all affected life forms. The more complex the neural activity of the unit is, the greater the interference, resulting in a more destructive effect to the affected organism.<end>

segment.source: I presume the Cube is with Tchort.<end>
segment.target: I presume the Cube is with Tchort.<end>

segment.source: Correct. The Cube was brought to it by the Tchortists. Before we weren't certain how the Cube reached the Institute of Tchort; your mind clarified that to us.<end>
segment.target: Correct. The Cube was brought to it by the Tchortists. Before we weren't certain how the Cube reached the Institute of Tchort; your mind clarified that to us.<end>

segment.source: I see. But you can't get past the field to retrieve it, right?<end>
segment.target: I see. But you can't get past the field to retrieve it, right?<end>

segment.source: I see. I had other things to ask you.<end>
segment.target: I see. I had other things to ask you.<end>

segment.source: Was Cornell this agent?<end>
segment.target: Was Cornell this agent?<end>

segment.source: No. And you yourself know that he is not the one.<end>
segment.target: No. And you yourself know that he is not the one.<end>

segment.source: Who was it then?<end>
segment.target: Who was it then?<end>

segment.source: Lora Baker met him in Core City. Other than that we have no information on him.<end>
segment.target: Lora Baker met him in Core City. Other than that we have no information on him.<end>

segment.source: Are you implying it could be used as a weapon?<end>
segment.target: Are you implying it could be used as a weapon?<end>

segment.source: Possibly.<end>
segment.target: Possibly.<end>

segment.source: Disastrous? Only for the Faceless, or all of us?<end>
segment.target: Disastrous? Only for the Faceless, or all of us?<end>

segment.source: It depends.<end>
segment.target: It depends.<end>

segment.source: For what?<end>
segment.target: For what?<end>

segment.source: Are you trying to tell me that everything from Core City invasion to wiping out of the Institute of Tchort was because of some fancy-looking battery?<end>
segment.target: Are you trying to tell me that everything from Core City invasion to wiping out of the Institute of Tchort was because of some fancy-looking battery?<end>

segment.source: You are making understatements. You do not understand its importance to us and I don't expect you to.<end>
segment.target: You are making understatements. You do not understand its importance to us and I don't expect you to.<end>

segment.source: I'm just curious.<end>
segment.target: I'm just curious.<end>

segment.source: It turned half of South Underrail upside down. Many lives were lost because of it.<end>
segment.target: It turned half of South Underrail upside down. Many lives were lost because of it.<end>

segment.source: What do I get if I can get you that cube?<end>
segment.target: What do I get if I can get you that cube?<end>

segment.source: You will be rewarded. As to what the reward will be, that has yet to be determined. Also, you will be able to leave Deep Caverns.<end>
segment.target: You will be rewarded. As to what the reward will be, that has yet to be determined. Also, you will be able to leave Deep Caverns.<end>

segment.source: Why will I be able to leave only after taking the cube from Tchort?<end>
segment.target: Why will I be able to leave only after taking the cube from Tchort?<end>

segment.source: The only exit without the use of tunnelers could be an elevator south of here. It is the only one functional, but it is unpowered.<end>
segment.target: The only exit without the use of tunnelers could be an elevator south of here. It is the only one functional, but it is unpowered.<end>

segment.source: How do I power the thing?<end>
segment.target: How do I power the thing?<end>

segment.source: There are two possible locations: The power station north of here and the Tchortist base to the west. The power station has been operational for many years since the dissolution of Biocorp, while the Tchortist base uses its own power.<end>
segment.target: There are two possible locations: The power station north of here and the Tchortist base to the west. The power station has been operational for many years since the dissolution of Biocorp, while the Tchortist base uses its own power.<end>

segment.source: I have already been to the power station, but I could not power the elevator.<end>
segment.target: I have already been to the power station, but I could not power the elevator.<end>

segment.source: Then your best option is to use the Tchortist generators. There is a high probability that the generators are placed close to Tchort's location, as it is the most secure.<end>
segment.target: Then your best option is to use the Tchortist generators. There is a high probability that the generators are placed close to Tchort's location, as it is the most secure.<end>

segment.source: What can you tell me about this power station?<end>
segment.target: What can you tell me about this power station?<end>

segment.source: It is protected by automated security only; nothing organic is allowed inside, as the sentry bots exist in overwhelming numbers, even too much for us to successfully combat.<end>
segment.target: It is protected by automated security only; nothing organic is allowed inside, as the sentry bots exist in overwhelming numbers, even too much for us to successfully combat.<end>

segment.source: Got it. I had other questions.<end>
segment.target: Got it. I had other questions.<end>

segment.source: How about you return Lora to SGS after the cube gets back in your hands?<end>
segment.target: How about you return Lora to SGS after the cube gets back in your hands?<end>

segment.source: Then it will be possible to arrange her transportation.<end>
segment.target: Then it will be possible to arrange her transportation.<end>

segment.source: That seems reasonable. I had other questions.<end>
segment.target: That seems reasonable. I had other questions.<end>

segment.source: How can I get out of Deep Caverns?<end>
segment.target: How can I get out of Deep Caverns?<end>

segment.source: Can we return Lora to South Gate Station somehow?<end>
segment.target: Can we return Lora to South Gate Station somehow?<end>

segment.source: No. It is impossible at the moment.<end>
segment.target: No. It is impossible at the moment.<end>

segment.source: Why not?<end>
segment.target: Why not?<end>

segment.source: Our resources are necessary elsewhere. The device is our priority right now; everything else is of less importance.<end>
segment.target: Our resources are necessary elsewhere. The device is our priority right now; everything else is of less importance.<end>

segment.source: And after you get the device?<end>
segment.target: And after you get the device?<end>

segment.source: I see. I had other questions.<end>
segment.target: I see. I had other questions.<end>

segment.source: Never mind. Let me ask you something else.<end>
segment.target: Never mind. Let me ask you something else.<end>

segment.source: You may ask.<end>
segment.target: You may ask.<end>

segment.source: There is a large gate deep inside the complex that I can't get past. Do you know anything that could help me open it?<end>
segment.target: There is a large gate deep inside the complex that I can't get past. Do you know anything that could help me open it?<end>

segment.source: No. We have some information on it, but nothing you will be able to use.<end>
segment.target: No. We have some information on it, but nothing you will be able to use.<end>

segment.source: What I may tell you is that the gate is being viciously protected by Tchort's endless hordes, and that behind it lies Tchort itself as well as what you know as "the cube."<end>
segment.target: What I may tell you is that the gate is being viciously protected by Tchort's endless hordes, and that behind it lies Tchort itself as well as what you know as "the cube."<end>

segment.source: I had other questions to ask you.<end>
segment.target: I had other questions to ask you.<end>

segment.source: I rescued one of you in Core City. Where is he now? Is he alive?<end>
segment.target: I rescued one of you in Core City. Where is he now? Is he alive?<end>

segment.source: No. He perished during the invasion of the Institute.<end>
segment.target: No. He perished during the invasion of the Institute.<end>

segment.source: You said it as if you don't care about him.<end>
segment.target: You said it as if you don't care about him.<end>

segment.source: You are wrong. We care, and we grieve, but our perception of the world, of life, is much different than yours, and so are our emotions. That is all I may share on the subject.<end>
segment.target: You are wrong. We care, and we grieve, but our perception of the world, of life, is much different than yours, and so are our emotions. That is all I may share on the subject.<end>

segment.source: At least he died fighting for a cause he believed in.<end>
segment.target: At least he died fighting for a cause he believed in.<end>

segment.source: His contribution was indeed significant.<end>
segment.target: His contribution was indeed significant.<end>

segment.source: I had hoped I'd meet him again.<end>
segment.target: I had hoped I'd meet him again.<end>

segment.source: I'm afraid that is now impossible. Do not concern yourself with his death; it could prove to be a dangerous distraction.<end>
segment.target: I'm afraid that is now impossible. Do not concern yourself with his death; it could prove to be a dangerous distraction.<end>

segment.source: We have seen it in your mind, but that individual hasn't managed to merge with our forces. He likely perished after you helped him.<end>
segment.target: We have seen it in your mind, but that individual hasn't managed to merge with our forces. He likely perished after you helped him.<end>

segment.source: I rescued one of you in Core City, then later I met him in the Institute's West Wing. Where is he now? Is he alive?<end>
segment.target: I rescued one of you in Core City, then later I met him in the Institute's West Wing. Where is he now? Is he alive?<end>

segment.source: I have no questions at the moment. Goodbye.<end>
segment.target: I have no questions at the moment. Goodbye.<end>

segment.source:
::You find yourself face-to-face with an armored Faceless of imposing stature. Not a single patch of flesh is left exposed: Cascading shoulder plates, thick breast piece engraved with a strange symbol, joint pads and even a skirt-like garment made from thick cloth all serve to encase and protect the being inside. But, the tri-horned helmet with a singular, cyclopean lens staring at you is this Faceless' most prominent feature. Whether there is one, two or more eyes behind that lens is not something that's immediately clear, but the powerful weapon grafted into the right arm suggests that monoscopic vision would make its use fairly difficult.
Eventually, a synthesized voice addresses you.::<end>
segment.target:
::You find yourself face-to-face with an armored Faceless of imposing stature. Not a single patch of flesh is left exposed: Cascading shoulder plates, thick breast piece engraved with a strange symbol, joint pads and even a skirt-like garment made from thick cloth all serve to encase and protect the being inside. Whether there is one, two or more eyes behind that lens is not something that's immediately clear, but the powerful weapon grafted into the right arm suggests that monoscopic vision would make its use fairly difficult.

segment.source: Please stand still while we extract information from your mind. There is nothing for you to fear.<end>
segment.target: Please stand still while we extract information from your mind. There is nothing for you to fear.<end>

segment.source: Extract information from my mind? What? How... and why?<end>
segment.target: Extract information from my mind? What? How... and why?<end>

segment.source: Fear not: The process is quick and painless. We simply wish to know what you know.<end>
segment.target: Fear not: The process is quick and painless. We simply wish to know what you know.<end>

segment.source: Okay. Do what you have to do.<end>
segment.target: Okay. Do what you have to do.<end>

segment.source: Good.<end>
segment.target: Good.<end>

segment.source: ::Let them look into your thoughts.::<end>
segment.target: ::Let them look into your thoughts.::<end>

segment.source: I am not giving you permission to read my thoughts.<end>
segment.target: I am not giving you permission to read my thoughts.<end>

segment.source: You have no alternatives. Allowing us to look into your mind is the only option we offer. Failure to comply will result in dire consequences.<end>
segment.target: You have no alternatives. Allowing us to look into your mind is the only option we offer. Failure to comply will result in dire consequences.<end>

segment.source: No. ::Fight!::<end>
segment.target: No. ::Fight!::<end>

segment.source: Why? Is this really necessary?<end>
segment.target: Why? Is this really necessary?<end>

segment.source: I'm already familiar with the procedure. Let's get this over with.<end>
segment.target: I'm already familiar with the procedure. Let's get this over with.<end>

segment.source:
::You now feel fully conscious and a part of the real world. The first thing that welcomes you back is the harsh sound of a distorted Faceless voice.::
<end>
segment.target:
::You now feel fully conscious and a part of the real world. The first thing that welcomes you back is the harsh sound of a distorted Faceless voice.::
<end>

segment.source: You are a spy. We know that you have allied yourself with the Tchortists in Deep Caverns, and that your arrival here is for the purpose of espionage.<end>
segment.target: You are a spy. We know that you have allied yourself with the Tchortists in Deep Caverns, and that your arrival here is for the purpose of espionage.<end>

segment.source: Wait, wait! You got this all wrong! Allow me to explain to you what really happened.<end>
segment.target: Wait, wait! You got this all wrong! Allow me to explain to you what really happened.<end>

segment.source: No. Your mind did that for you. Now you will die.<end>
segment.target: No. Your mind did that for you. Now you will die.<end>

segment.source: ::Fight!::<end>
segment.target: ::Fight!::<end>

segment.source: Now what happens?<end>
segment.target: Now what happens?<end>

segment.source: Now you die.<end>
segment.target: Now you die.<end>

segment.source: Here's something for you: I'm about to stack so many Faceless corpses that I'm gonna be able to climb them back to Lower Underrail! ::Attack!::<end>
segment.target: Here's something for you: I'm about to stack so many Faceless corpses that I'm gonna be able to climb them back to Lower Underrail! ::Attack!::<end>

segment.source: Well done. You have fully cooperated with us on every occasion where cooperation was possible. <end>
segment.target: Well done. You have fully cooperated with us on every occasion where cooperation was possible. <end>

segment.source: Some of us have died by your hand, but you will suffer no consequences for those deaths; we understand the circumstances in which they occured.<end>
segment.target: Some of us have died by your hand, but you will suffer no consequences for those deaths; we understand the circumstances in which they occured.<end>

segment.source: <end>
segment.target: <end>

segment.source: The fact that you didn't join the Tchortists ranks is also something you should be commended on, considering that the alternative path you took in order to reach your goals is a much more challenging one.<end>
segment.target: The fact that you didn't join the Tchortists ranks is also something you should be commended on, considering that the alternative path you took in order to reach your goals is a much more challenging one.<end>

segment.source: We deem you trustworthy, $(context.player.Name). We are interested in prolonging our cooperation.<end>
segment.target: We deem you trustworthy, $(context.player.Name). We are interested in prolonging our cooperation.<end>

segment.source: We can offer you supplies, free passage through Faceless-held territory and safety within any of our bases of operations.<end>
segment.target: We can offer you supplies, free passage through Faceless-held territory and safety within any of our bases of operations.<end>

segment.source: We know that you are looking for Lora Baker and her husband Terry. <end>
segment.target: We know that you are looking for Lora Baker and her husband Terry. <end>

segment.source:
She was severely wounded before she was found by one of our tunneler units. Otherwise, she would've perished.
She is in the medical office and you may speak to her if you wish.<end>
segment.target:
She was severely wounded before she was found by one of our tunneler units. Otherwise, she would've perished.
She is in the medical office and you may speak to her if you wish.<end>

segment.source:
I have granted you the right to three ammo and one medical package.
The building with the double doors is the barracks; there you may speak to a quadrupedal regarding ammo supplies. Next to it is the medical office, to which you should go for the medical package.
If you have any further questions you may speak only to me.<end>
segment.target:
I have granted you the right to three ammo and one medical package.
The building with the double doors is the barracks; there you may speak to a quadrupedal regarding ammo supplies. Next to it is the medical office, to which you should go for the medical package.
If you have any further questions you may speak only to me.<end>

segment.source: I do have questions, as a matter of fact.<end>
segment.target: I do have questions, as a matter of fact.<end>

segment.source: Nothing for now. Talk to you later.<end>
segment.target: Nothing for now. Talk to you later.<end>

segment.source: You have no memory of Lora and Terry Baker, but due to both of them being from South Gate Station, you should know that Lora is here with us. <end>
segment.target: You have no memory of Lora and Terry Baker, but due to both of them being from South Gate Station, you should know that Lora is here with us. <end>

segment.source: Your previous allegiance with the Tchortists will not be held against you, since it proved necessary in tracking down the object you know as "the Cube." We find your knowledge regarding it useful.<end>
segment.target: Your previous allegiance with the Tchortists will not be held against you, since it proved necessary in tracking down the object you know as "the Cube." We find your knowledge regarding it useful.<end>

segment.source: Good. You have cooperated with us on a few occasions, proving yourself both trustworthy and useful. <end>
segment.target: Good. You have cooperated with us on a few occasions, proving yourself both trustworthy and useful. <end>

segment.source: We now know everything. The penalty for your actions against us is death.<end>
segment.target: We now know everything. The penalty for your actions against us is death.<end>

segment.source: Wait! Let's talk!<end>
segment.target: Wait! Let's talk!<end>

segment.source: No. You cannot tell us anything we don't already know.<end>
segment.target: No. You cannot tell us anything we don't already know.<end>

segment.source: If you truly "knew," you would've paid more attention to my body count, freaks! ::Fight!::<end>
segment.target: If you truly "knew," you would've paid more attention to my body count, freaks! ::Fight!::<end>

segment.source: We now know everything. Your interaction with us so far does not designate you as our enemy, but neither as someone worthy of being our ally. You have nothing to offer to us other than the few bits of information we have already extracted from you.<end>
segment.target: We now know everything. Your interaction with us so far does not designate you as our enemy, but neither as someone worthy of being our ally. You have nothing to offer to us other than the few bits of information we have already extracted from you.<end>

segment.source: I will ask you to leave now. Our patrols will not engage you, but you are advised not to interfere in our affairs.<end>
segment.target: I will ask you to leave now. Our patrols will not engage you, but you are advised not to interfere in our affairs.<end>

segment.source: But... there are so many questions I had for you.<end>
segment.target: But... there are so many questions I had for you.<end>

segment.source: We know, but they will not be answered. Leave.<end>
segment.target: We know, but they will not be answered. Leave.<end>

segment.source: ::Leave.::<end>
segment.target: ::Leave.::<end>

segment.source: If that is what you want, then I am in no position to object. Goodbye.<end>
segment.target: If that is what you want, then I am in no position to object. Goodbye.<end>
